_info: Events on the act map (each at most once per run). target = whom the event concerns, the event appears only when the target exists: melee (a random tank, cavalier or assassin), priest, oath (a hero with an oath), unbonded_pair (two heroes without a bond), fallen_successor (the successor of the last fallen hero). Texts may use {hero}, {a}, {b}, {fallen}. options[].effects: glory (+/-; negative = cost, unavailable without enough glory), heal / wound {who: all|random|random2|wounded|target, frac}, gift (passive|oath, who: target), fled {key: count} (return at the boss), oath_choice n (choose an oath from n), passive_choice n (choose a passive from n for the target), max_hp_choice v (a chosen hero +v Toughness for good), chance p {win, lose, win_text, lose_text}, pair_wins ±n (the event's pair), next_battle {remove_pods n | pair_stats {stat: v}}, inherit (the successor inherits a passive of the fallen), perm_stats {stat: v} (target, for good), oath_boost {mult, break_cost} (target's oath), release_oath (target). text = what is written to the chronicle. Relics (2.3e) and ability swaps (2.3d) will replace the stand-ins in kaple, kovar, opusteny_tabor and mnich. ability_choice = choose an ability swap from n (who: target = only the event's hero).

poutnik.name: The Pilgrim by the Road
poutnik.text: An old pilgrim in a ragged cloak sits at the crossroads. He claims he once served the Count, and offers to hear the oath of anyone who dares.

options.label: Swear an oath before the pilgrim
options.hint: Choose an oath from two, for a hero without one.
options.text: An oath was sworn before the pilgrim at the crossroads.

options.label: Give him alms (15 glory)
options.hint: The pilgrim blesses the house: everyone heals 25 %.
options.text: The house gave the pilgrim alms and he blessed it.

options.label: Ride on
options.hint: Nothing happens.

vypalena_ves.name: The Burned Village
vypalena_ves.text: Only smouldering beams are left of the village. The brigands who set it alight are running for the forest with their loot.

options.label: Pursue the arsonists
options.hint: +30 glory, one hero is wounded (40 % health).
options.text: The house caught the arsonists of the burned village.

options.label: Help the survivors
options.hint: You gain nothing, but 3 brigands escape and return in the fight with the Captain.
options.text: The house helped the survivors of the burned village; the arsonists vanished into the forest.

zajatec.name: The Captured Brigand
zajatec.text: The watch has caught a young brigand. He begs for his life and offers to reveal where his fellows hid healing herbs.

options.label: Execute him
options.hint: +10 glory.
options.text: The captured brigand was executed.

options.label: Release him for the herbs
options.hint: Everyone heals 20 %, but the brigand returns in the fight with the Captain.
options.text: The captured brigand revealed the herb cache and was released.

kaple.name: The Forest Chapel
kaple.text: Deep in the forest stands an abandoned chapel. A silver reliquary lies on the altar, a strange silence around it.

options.label: Pray
options.hint: Wounds heal by 30 %.
options.text: The house prayed in the forest chapel.

options.label: Take the reliquary
options.hint: One hero gains a random passive, everyone loses 15 % health.
options.text: The house carried off the reliquary from the forest chapel.

turnaj.name: Tournament at the Ford
turnaj.text: Knights of the Count hold a tournament at the ford. Their herald calls out {hero} by name: will the House of the Wolf answer the challenge?

options.label: Send {hero} to the lists
options.hint: 60 %: +30 glory and a passive for {hero}; otherwise {hero} is wounded (50 % health).

effects.lose_text: {hero} was thrown from the saddle and carried off the field.

options.text: {hero} rode into the lists.

options.label: Decline
options.hint: Nothing happens.

kovar.name: The Smith Below the Castle
kovar.text: In the village below the castle a smith hammers mail for the Count's men. For good coin he will rework a knight's armour.

options.label: Rework a hero's armour (25 glory)
options.hint: A chosen hero gets Toughness +10 % for good.
options.text: The smith reworked armour for the house.

options.label: Retrain a hero for a new weapon (40 glory)
options.hint: A hero learns another ability of his class (choose from 2); refinements of the old one are lost.
options.text: The smith forged new arms for the house.

options.label: Leave
options.hint: Nothing happens.

opusteny_tabor.name: The Abandoned Brigand Camp
opusteny_tabor.text: A brigand camp, abandoned in a hurry. Something may still be hidden here, or someone may still be watching.

options.label: Search the camp
options.hint: 50 %: +20 glory; otherwise two heroes are wounded (20 % health).

effects.win_text: The house found the brigands' hidden spoils.
effects.lose_text: A trap went off in the camp.

options.text: The house searched the abandoned camp.

options.label: Burn it down
options.hint: +15 glory, but 2 brigands escape and return in the fight with the Captain.
options.text: The house burned the brigand camp.

zbeh.name: The Deserter
zbeh.text: A brigand comes to the camp with his hands up. He swears he is done with Kuno and offers to lead one of his old bands into a trap.

options.label: Trust him
options.hint: The next battle has one enemy group fewer.
options.text: The deserter led a band of brigands away from the fight.

options.label: Execute him
options.hint: +10 glory.
options.text: The deserter was executed.

mnich.name: The Monk with the Book
mnich.text: A wandering monk carries an old book of prayers. {hero} recognises it: a rare text of the order.

options.label: Let {hero} study it
options.hint: {hero} learns a passive (choose from 2), but loses 25 % health from the long vigil.
options.text: {hero} spent the night over the monk's book.

options.label: Let {hero} learn a new prayer
options.hint: {hero} swaps his ability for another priest ability (choose from 2); refinements of the old one are lost.
options.text: {hero} learned a new prayer from the monk's book.

options.label: Read it to the whole house
options.hint: Everyone heals 20 %.
options.text: The monk read to the house by the fire.

spor.name: A Quarrel in the Tent
spor.text: Raised voices in the tent: {a} and {b} are at each other's throats over who held the line in the last fight.

options.label: Side with {a}
options.hint: {a} and {b} lose a shared victory.
options.text: The house sided with {a}; {b} did not forget it.

options.label: Reconcile them (20 glory)
options.hint: {a} and {b} gain a shared victory.
options.text: {a} and {b} were reconciled over wine.

options.label: Let it be
options.hint: {a} and {b} get Attack −15 % in the next battle.
options.text: {a} and {b} went to bed still angry.

hrob.name: The Grave of an Ancestor
hrob.text: By the road the house finds the fresh grave of {fallen}. His successor {hero} stands over it in silence.

options.label: Honour {fallen}
options.hint: {hero} inherits one of {fallen}'s passives.
options.text: The house honoured {fallen} at his grave.

options.label: Take up his weapon (10 glory)
options.hint: {hero} gets Attack +15 % for good.
options.text: {hero} took up the weapon of {fallen}.

soud.name: The Trial of the Oath
soud.text: A priest of the order asks {hero} to renew his oath before witnesses, or to lay it down.

options.label: Confirm the oath
options.hint: The oath's bonuses of {hero} +50 %, but breaking it costs 40 glory.
options.text: {hero} renewed his oath before witnesses.

options.label: Lay it down
options.hint: {hero} is released from his oath without shame.
options.text: {hero} laid down his oath.
